CSS Pseudo-elements

::before

This element has a ::before pseudo-element.

::after

This element has an ::after pseudo-element.

::before + ::after (quotation marks)

This text is wrapped in decorative quotation marks.

::first-letter

The first letter of this paragraph is styled as a drop cap with a larger size and different color.

::first-line

The first line of this paragraph is styled differently from the rest. This effect is commonly used in typography to draw attention to the beginning of a paragraph. The remaining text flows normally without any special styling applied to it.

Decorative ::before (block element)

This box has a decorative circle inserted via ::before.
